name: Magic in the Blood
text:
**Magic in the Blood** (race trait; Changeling)

You possess natural magical ability. Select one of the following spells: bleed, create water, dancing lights, detect good, ghost sound, putrefy food and drink. You can cast this spell three times per day as a spell-like ability.
